data: What is the approximate value of the Precision of 'tf.idf (5-grams)' at Recall 0.2?

The question asks for the approximate value of the Precision of 'tf.idf (5-grams)' at Recall 0.2. From the figure, we can see that the line representing 'tf.idf (5-grams)' is the purple line. We need to find where this line intersects with the vertical line corresponding to Recall = 0.2 on the x-axis. 

Looking at the graph, the 'tf.idf (5-grams)' line appears to intersect with the Recall = 0.2 line around the y-axis value of approximately 0.1. Therefore, the approximate value of the Precision of 'tf.idf (5-grams)' at Recall 0.2 is 0.1.
